agent.final_text:
The bug was in `rotate_file` in `boltons/fileutils.py`. All 13 tests in `tests/test_fileutils.py` now pass.

**Cause:** `rotate_file` renamed every file up by one, then deleted the highest-numbered backup (`kept_names[-1]`). That file was the one it had just rotated into place, so the newest backup was lost. With `keep=1`, the only backup, `log.1.txt`, was deleted every time. With `keep=5`, the last file, `.5`, was deleted instead of the oldest dropped one.

**Fix:** I moved the deletion of `kept_names[-1]` to before the renames. The oldest backup is now removed first to make room, and the rename chain no longer ends by deleting what it just created.
